ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Revolutions Sociology Advisor's approval required The course will focus on the understanding of ‘Revolutions’ as the mover and manifestation of deep socio-political change. We will read and discuss foundational texts as well as new interpretations to explore both theories and histories of the 'classical' and the 21st Century revolutionary movements. Examples may include, among others, the Cuban, Nicaraguan, Iranian experiences as well as the Arab Spring.
